question: Should maintainers land this read-only catalog mitigation now, or require live Telegram proof first?
rationale: The patch and tests look correct, but the PR is maintainer-labeled and the remaining live Telegram proof gap is a human confidence choice rather than a narrow code repair.

options.title: Land after required checks
options.body: Accept the regression/Testbox proof and merge the focused read-only catalog fix once required checks are green or intentionally cleared.

options.title: Request live Telegram proof
options.body: Ask for a short redacted Telegram Desktop or bot run showing bare `/think` returns promptly before landing.

options.title: Pause the mitigation
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want a different product tradeoff between fresh discovery and menu responsiveness.

recommendation.title: Land after required checks
